demand_inventory.description: Measure incidence and reflection from the surface normal.

Relate index to speed and wavelength while frequency stays fixed.
Use supplied wavelength-dependent indices.
Require high-to-low travel above critical angle.
Use f=R/2 with mirror-type sign.

Interpret q sign as real or virtual.
Use principal concave/convex mirror rays.
Classify converging positive-f and diverging negative-f lenses.
Use 1/p+1/q=1/f.
Interpret signed q and magnification.
Use P=1/f with f in meters.
Use principal lens rays for image location.
Use each intermediate image as the next object relation.
Translate intermediate location into signed next-object distance.
Distinguish wavelength-dependent and ray-height aberration cues.
Reason at listed depth about instruments and retinal image/correction.

changed_task_decision_points.decision_point: Near applies equal angles; changed rotates the normal and requires the factor-of-two reflected-direction update.
near_trace: Reflect at equal angle opposite side.

changed_task_decision_points.decision_point: Near identifies TIR; changed uses wavelength-specific indices to predict dispersion.
Near solves an inside-focus image; changed transfers fixed principal-ray rules to a new object location.
Near solves inside-focus lens imaging; changed uses ray regions for an object beyond 2f.
Near propagates an intermediate image; changed classifies a wavelength-dependent focal defect.
